# Literature

This section contains selected literature notes from the ResearchOS Vault.

Each note may include:

- research question
- scientific background
- datasets and study area
- methodology
- experimental design
- principal results
- methodological or scientific innovation
- limitations
- important figures and tables
- relevance to current research
- related literature

Use the search field or table headings to filter and explore the literature collection.
